svg.title: WhatsApp invoice processing architecture
svg.desc: A WhatsApp user sends a message through Meta Cloud API to a FastAPI backend. The backend sends tasks to a Redis download queue consumed by a download worker. That worker queues OCR work for an OCR worker, which writes processed invoices to the database. A frontend reads and edits invoices through the backend.
svg.text: WhatsApp intake · asynchronous download and OCR · invoice review
Solid arrows show application data flow. Dashed arrow shows the download worker fetching media from Meta.
